seasons.title: TNAU Agritech Portal, horticulture
seasons.quote: The ideal season of planting is June to December.

tree_spacing_m.title: TNAU Agritech Portal, horticulture
tree_spacing_m.quote: Spacing 8 x 8 m (156 plants/ha) for conventional planting.

years_to_bear.title: NHB model project report
years_to_bear.quote: Sapota starts bearing from third year of planting but economic yields can be obtained from 5 th year onwards

water_need.title: NHB model project report
water_need.quote: Irrigation is provided at an interval of 30 days in winter and 15 days in summer
water_need.note: Interpreted: watering every 7-10 days or less is read as 'low', every few days as 'medium'; no source uses the low/medium/high scale. Agronomist to confirm.

expected_yield_kg_per_sqm.title: TNAU Agritech Portal, horticulture
expected_yield_kg_per_sqm.quote: Depending up on the variety the fruit yield ranges from 20 - 25 t/ha/year.

water_l_per_sqm_day.title: TNAU crop production guide: horticultural crops (2020)
water_l_per_sqm_day.quote: Daily water requirement of various fruit crops is given below: Crops Water requirement (lit/day/plant) Mango 30-50 Banana 20-25 Citrus 22-30 Guava 22-30 Sapota 20-30 Amla 15-25 Grapes 15-25 Papaya 15-25 For the young trees which are in their pre bearing stage, 1/3rd of the recommended dose of water may be given
water_l_per_sqm_day.note: 20 litres per tree per day (lower end of the range; 'Citrus' is used for orange) over the library's 8.0 m x 8.0 m spacing = 0.312 L per m² per day; young trees get one third. Agronomist to confirm.

source_notes: AI research batch 7 (2026-10-07). Ranges are stored at their lower bound; the source range is in each quote. Sowing months for Madhya Pradesh come from the state crop-season table; other values are from TNAU/NHB (Tamil Nadu and national) until a local source is found.
